instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, low angle. In an indoor studio, the man in the gray gi (R2) on the left is sitting on the mat, leaning forward to grip the hand of the man in the white gi (R1). The man in the white gi (R1) on the right is kneeling and leaning forward to engage. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the black mat.
elements: R2 is sitting on the mat while leaning forward to grip R1's hand
R1 is kneeling and leaning forward to engage R2
R2 is the hand-gripping participant and R1 is the engaged kneeling participant
R1 and R2 are making hand contact during a grappling/wrestling interaction
the interaction occurs on a black mat
the setting is an indoor studio
